listNote: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation’s official text, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 Nov 2026 and checked again against Push Square’s launch-day guide on 19 Nov 2026 and the GTA Zone / Sixshore launch guides on 20 Nov 2026. Counts (42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone race locations, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garages, 397 stunts, 18 card sets, 80 challenges, 100 WAiNK spots) are the counts PlayStation tracks for those trophies. Gamerscore values come from GTABase / TrueAchievements via GTA Zone and Sixshore and sum to 1,000. Hidden flags follow the 28 hidden trophies listed by Output Lag on 19 Nov 2026. GTA VI launched 19 Nov 2026; where a step is still not confirmed in-game at launch, the guide says so instead of guessing: five trophies are still unconfirmed and one carries a reported lead only.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do. Use this guide’s roadmap as the order and the checklist as the record; when the last bronze, silver or gold lands, this one follows automatically. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 and about 200 hours, Push Square 250 hours or more, so expect a long, steady run rather than a hard one: one playthrough, no online trophies, no difficulty settings, no mission medals.
steps: Finish the other 54 trophies in any order.
Use the roadmap stages to avoid the one missable trophy.
100% completion (A Long Road) is usually the last step.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Play it as the story asks — no side content is needed first, and it cannot be missed. It is one of 12 story trophies (11 bronze, 1 gold, 250 Gamerscore together) that all unlock automatically through the story.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission through.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop a little late, once you clear the first mission or two of the next chapter, so keep playing a few minutes past the last mission if it does not appear at once. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia’s balcony meditation — it is the one possibly missable trophy in the game, and Chapter 1 is the only place it appears.
steps: Play every Chapter 1 mission in order.
Before the chapter ends, do Lucia’s balcony meditation.
Keep playing into Chapter 2 if the trophy pops late.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Take the optional robbery and racing missions as they appear.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the hardest trophy in the game and the last one most players earn. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts, so grind as you go. PowerPyx calls the list lenient, closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions out of several hundred, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets — plus all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret’s target decks. PowerPyx puts the Platinum at about 200 hours, Push Square at 250 hours or more.
steps: Open the 100% checklist after the credits and work through it — see the checklist table below.
Grind the long counts early: stunts, challenges, vaults, vehicles, card sets.
Do 100 optional missions and study 100 animals as you travel.
Finish every robbery, underwater discovery, range, drone race and Bret deck.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count — PowerPyx counts 397 in the game: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, so you need a little over half. Track them on the map under Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots, and your progress under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. Keep going past 250 — 100% completion needs 300.
steps: Attempt stunts as you travel; jumps and flights all count.
Check the counter under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
Use the map’s Stunt Spots to find the ones left.
Push past 250 toward 300 for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Sampling one of each is enough — you do not need to win or finish anything, just try it. The Activities tab under Progress shows which types you have tried, so check it as you go.
steps: Open Progress, then Activities, to see the nine types.
Try one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, a range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt.
Check the tab again — all nine ticked means the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two ranges — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — with 42 gold medals between them, most challenges in three difficulty tiers, some locked until you meet their conditions. Find them on the map under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and track golds under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges. Learn each challenge’s weapon and scoring, then repeat it until the gold threshold clears. All 42 are also needed for 100% completion.
steps: Visit both shooting ranges: Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn, Griffin in Balsero.
Gold each challenge; the range shows its medal thresholds.
Unlock locked challenges by meeting their conditions first.
Repeat until all 42 golds are earned.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations and 42 races in total, and some charge an entry fee — bring cash. Win at least one race at each location; you do not need to win every race, just one per location. Find them on the map under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Win one race there, then move to the next location.
Bring cash — some locations charge an entry fee.
Keep going to all 42 races for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count out of 40 in the game — street races, drone races and the other race types. Repeat wins on the same race do not add to the count, so keep moving to new events. The counter tracks distinct wins, and this trophy also feeds Earn Cash, Not Kudos progress while you chase the Top Fun drone races.
steps: Enter races across Leonida — street, drone and the rest.
Win 20 different ones; the counter tracks distinct wins.
Do not repeat the same race: only new wins count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Reported time-sensitive: take the challenge when Cal offers it — it may not come back.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon; he asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg — fish in the marked area until one of that size bites. The challenge is a one-off strand moment: take it the moment he offers it, and treat it as time-sensitive. You need a boat with a fishing rod; plenty sit in the area to borrow if you do not own one. Reel in when the line slackens, ease off when it strains.
steps: Accept Cal’s fishing challenge when it appears in Chapter 1.
Fish the marked area for a Parrotfish over 2 kg.
Win the challenge; keep a save from before it, just in case.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: THE missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 spots in 10 locations, for Jason and Lucia. The one you can miss is Lucia’s balcony meditation in Chapter 1: one morning at Jason’s house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept the optional quest; it takes a minute and removes the risk. PowerPyx reports that it raises the meditation counter by one, though it is not marked as a meditation spot like the other 18, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. A meditation only counts once the final “zen” animation has played. Track your spots under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so the missable one cannot cost you A Long Road.
steps: In Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation before the chapter ends.
Meditate at every spot, bringing your partner to outdoor spots.
Wait for the “zen” animation at each spot — that is what marks it complete.
Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale
roadmap.advice: Play the story straight through — 5 chapters, 60–80 hours — but keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Do Lucia’s balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends: it is the one reported missable. Do not start the final mission until stages 2 and 3 are done.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side characters
roadmap.advice: Clear the five side-character finales, the 8 stranger strands and Bret’s hunt before the finale. Start each strand the moment its marker appears, and race Yago the moment the hourglass shows in Chapter 3. Only Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward the 8 strands.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.advice: Try all 9 activity types once, win the drone races and the 20 races, beat Cal at fishing, and work on the 250 stunts and the 42 gold Shooting Range challenges. This is the longest skill stage — start it early and chip at it between story missions.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.advice: Meditate at all 18 spots with your partner along, finish 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles and explore all 52 areas. Sweep the map region by region so nothing is left behind.

roadmap.title: Heists, combat and the wanted level
roadmap.advice: The robbery tools arrive in Chapters 3 and 4. Do the partner trophies while Jason and Lucia are together, bring your partner to every vault, and keep a getaway car ready for every robbery.

roadmap.title: Money, secrets and the Platinum
roadmap.advice: Launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles, then let the choice counter and the strange-event trophies finish. The 100% checklist is about 100 hours on its own — see the checklist table. 100% completion pops A Long Road, and the Platinum follows.

platinum.cheats: 61 cheats, all locked until after the story; using one disables trophies, achievements and saving
platinum.noReplay: No mission replay, no New Game+, no difficulty settings, no mission medals
platinum.cleanupHours: About 10 hours for Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
